thread.title: Strong iPhone XS Sales Could Lift Beleaguered Apple Chip Suppliers | Investor's Business Daily

author: PATRICK SEITZ
title: Strong iPhone XS Sales Could Lift Beleaguered Apple Chip Suppliers | Investor's Business Daily
text:
Apple chip suppliers should benefit from stronger-than-expected sales of iPhone XS series handsets, a Wall Street analyst said Thursday.
X KeyBanc Capital Markets analyst John Vinh said demand for Apple 's ( AAPL ) new iPhone XS and XS Max handsets appears stronger than for last year's iPhone 8 series and X phones.
"Our initial round of carrier surveys for the current iPhone XS cycle indicates solid sell-through for the iPhone XS/Max as inventories are lean post launch," Vinh said in a report to clients. "Demand for the iPhone XS Max has been the strongest, with the majority of stores being sold out."
Consumers are attracted to the large screen sizes of the new handsets, he said. The iPhone XS has a 5.8-inch display while the XS Max has a 6.5-inch display.

Buy Ratings Kept On Apple Chip Suppliers Based on early iPhone XS sales, Vinh reiterated his overweight ratings on iPhone component suppliers Broadcom ( AVGO ), Qorvo ( QRVO ), Skyworks Solutions ( SWKS ) and Synaptics ( SYNA ). He kept his sector weight rating on Cirrus Logic ( CRUS ).
Shares of Apple chip suppliers have been beaten down in recent months over concerns about softening smartphone sales. Replacement rates have extended as consumers hold on to their current handsets for longer periods between upgrades.
Apple stock dropped 1.8% to 227.99 on the stock market today . Broadcom dipped 0.5% to 248.17. Cirrus Logic slid 1% to 37.44. Qorvo lost a fraction to 76.17. Skyworks fell 1.5% to 91.05. Synaptics tumbled 3.9% to 41.86.
